comparison.inference: The tested positive-frequency USB noise, including a level above the0.5W telemetry condition, did not reproduce the native preamble stop. This narrows the comparison but does not prove whether PD mode, spectral width, two-sided complex-noise statistics, detector behavior or another difference causes the disputed reading.

offline_source_replay.scope: Algorithmic double-precision replay of the default native generator; not captured native TX IQ and not a byte-exact C execution. Prototype proper-complex variant is offline only.
offline_source_replay.interpretation: The native wide band crosses zero. Its real-input complex filter preserves strong conjugate correlation where positive and negative bands overlap. Positive-frequency USB noise has different complex statistics as well as narrower spectrum, so its passed RF test cannot establish native-preamble behavior.
